title: The Capsule Keeper
description: It's the 75th annual Capsule Day on Snazzie FM. The committee chair calls in glowing about the unbroken streak, this year's brand-new Keeper of the Year calls in thrilled to be sealed in with the capsule, and the records volunteer quietly reads the ledger line nobody wanted read.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and happy Capsule Day. Seventy-five years running, this town buries a brand-new time capsule and digs up the one from fifty years back. <p:0.3> Folks, now THAT'S a tradition.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Seventy-five years. <p:0.3> Same hole, basically. That's the part I keep landing on.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: Oh, it's an honor, Ronnie. Marv here, Capsule Committee. <p:0.3> Seventy-five years, we have never once missed a Keeper. You don't break a streak like that.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A Keeper every single year. <p:0.3> Marv, that right there is heritage you can hold in your hands.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hold on. A Keeper. <p:0.3> What exactly does the Keeper keep, Marv?

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: The capsule, Barry. <p:0.3> A real Keeper holds the line. Goes down with it, keeps it company, keeps it safe. That's the highest honor in this town.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: And I cannot believe I got picked! Chad here, this year's Keeper of the Year. <p:0.3> Honestly? Huge honor, great exposure. I'm already standing in the hole, it's a beautiful hole, very on-brand.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Listen to that energy. <p:0.3> A founder's spirit. Chad, you are going to be down there a long, long time.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Doreen, records volunteer. <p:0.3> Per the ledger, I should note the town stopped burying objects in the capsules around nineteen sixty-one. <p:0.3> Every capsule since has a Keeper in it. Just the one Keeper.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> Just the Keeper. <p:0.3> So the capsule is the person, Doreen.

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: It's an HONOR, Barry. You don't break a streak like that. Seventy-five Keepers, seventy-five years, not one gap in the record.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Right, and the honor is the win for me, networking-wise. <p:0.3> So real quick, what time do I climb back out? I've got a thing at six.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Per the ledger, no Keeper has a climb-out time. <p:0.3> There's a column for it. <p:0.3> It's blank. All seventy-five rows.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, Chad, that's not a problem. That's a commitment. <p:0.3> The honor goes one way. Down.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: One way. <p:0.3> Okay, see, I love a one-way honor, but in a fundraising sense, not a... not a soil sense.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Marv. <p:0.3> The dig-up crew today. The ones who pulled up the nineteen seventy-six capsule this morning. Were any of them on the crew last year?

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: Well, no. <p:0.3> Nobody's ever been on the dig-up crew twice, Barry. New crew every year. That's tradition too.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nobody twice. <p:0.3> Doreen, where do last year's crew go?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Per the ledger... that column's blank too, dear.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Okay, okay, time out. <p:0.3> Hold on. Who dug up the LAST one? The fifty-year-old one I'm replacing? Where's that Keeper, who pulled HIM out?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Nobody pulled him out, hon. <p:0.3> Per the ledger, we don't dig the old one up. <p:0.3> We just bury the new one on top.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: On TOP?! <p:0.3> Marv, there is no dig-up! It's just down, on down, on down!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: I would like to climb out of the hole now! The hole networking has CONCLUDED!

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: A real Keeper holds the line, Chad!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Per the ledger, row seventy-six.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: [surprise-ah] Why is there DIRT on my shoes?!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: One WAY, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, gentlemen, easy. <p:0.3> This is a sacred moment, not a circus.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's a little bit of a circus from down here, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Seventy-five years, never missed a Keeper. <p:0.3> Chad, congratulations. And don't you move.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Shovels are already moving, per the ledger.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Who's holding the shovels, Doreen?

lines.speaker: caller-marv
lines.text: The crew, Barry. <p:0.3> Same crew as always.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And there it is. <p:0.3> A brand-new crew, a brand-new Keeper, the streak unbroken. We'll be right back, Snazzie. <p:0.3> Now THAT'S a Capsule.
